[PREFERENCE] User is considering upgrading their road bike's pedals to clipless pedals for improved pedaling efficiency and reduced fatigue.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant explained what clipless pedals are, their benefits, and factors to consider when choosing them, including compatibility, pedal type, cleat type, float and release tension, weight and durability, and price.  
[EVENT] User has researched and is considering purchasing Shimano Ultegra pedals.  
[EVENT] User plans to order the pedals online and install them themselves.
